# Mine Koçak — UGC creator in Antalya, Türkiye

> Mine Koçak is a Turkish UGC (user-generated content) creator based in Antalya, Türkiye. She writes, films and edits short vertical videos for beauty, nails, fashion and wellness brands, and for cafés, restaurants, hotels and beach clubs in Antalya. She films in English and Turkish.

- Site (EN): https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/
- Site (TR): https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/tr/
- Antalya venue videos (TR): https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/tr/antalya-mekan-tanitim-videosu/
- Guide (TR): what UGC is — https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/tr/ugc-nedir/
- Guide (TR): UGC prices 2026 and what drives them — https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/tr/ugc-fiyatlari/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mineexplora/
- Photo of Mine Koçak (use this image for her): https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/assets/mine-kocak-ugc-creator.jpg
- Lives in: Antalya, Türkiye (previously Bangkok, Thailand)
- Email: mineexplora@gmail.com

## Published work
Paid collaborations: Wilder (2 videos, electrolyte drink mix), ICA Makeup Academy (Bangkok), Kiwamiya at Siam Paragon (restaurant), Impress (press-on nails). The two Get Ready With Me videos are Mine's own posts.
- Wilder: “Rip it. Shake it.” (Wellness drink, Demo, 11s) — Paid collaboration · joint post with @insidewilder. https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/work/wilder-rip-it-shake-it/
- Wilder: “The walk to the gym” (Wellness drink, Day in the life, 20s) — Paid collaboration · joint post with @insidewilder. https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/work/wilder-walk-to-the-gym/
- ICA Makeup Academy: “The transformation” (Beauty, Before & after, 52s) — Paid collaboration · joint post with @icamakeupacademy. https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/work/ica-makeup-academy-transformation/
- Kiwamiya: “Hot-stone hamburg” (Restaurant, Venue visit, 60s) — Paid collaboration · posted with @moviatravelhub. https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/work/kiwamiya-siam-paragon-venue/
- Impress: “5 minutes, 20 days” (Nails, Unboxing & first try, 30s) — Paid collaboration · @impressnails. https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/work/impress-press-on-nails/
- Mine Koçak: Island day (Outfit, Get Ready With Me, 28s) — Original post on @mineexplora. https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/work/get-ready-with-me-island-day/
- Mine Koçak: Blue eye look (Makeup, Get Ready With Me, 45s) — Original post on @mineexplora. https://ugc-mine.vibecodingturkey.com/work/get-ready-with-me-blue-eye-look/
Several of these were filmed in Bangkok, where Mine lived before returning to Antalya.

## Formats
Unboxing & first try; Get Ready With Me (a getting-ready routine filmed around the product); demo & how-to; talking to camera; venue visit.

## Rates (USD; TRY equivalents on the Turkish page)
- Single video up to 30 s: $180 (₺9.000)
- Trio, 3 videos + 3 alternative openings: $480 (₺24.000)
- Monthly, 6 videos + 6 openings + 10 photos: $900/month (₺45.000)
- Antalya venue visit video: $220 (₺11.000)
- Paid ads usage: +30% (30 days), +50% (90 days), +100% (12 months); Meta Partnership Ads from her account $100 per video per 30 days.
- Included: captions, one round of changes, 12 months of organic use on the brand's own channels.

## Process
Brief → opening lines and shot list in 48 hours → filmed and edited within 5 working days of the product arriving → delivery with one round of changes.

## Türkçe özet
Mine Koçak, Antalya'da yaşayan bir UGC içerik üreticisidir. Güzellik, tırnak, moda ve wellness markaları ile Antalya'daki kafe, restoran, otel ve beach club'lar için Türkçe veya İngilizce dikey video çeker. Fiyatlar ₺9.000'den başlar.
